title: CIC Interpolation
text: Interpolate signal using cascaded integrator-comb filter, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Section word lengths} sets Word length of filter sections [ 16 16 16 16; {Coefficient source} sets the source of filter information, {Interpolation factor (R)}, {Differential Delay (M)} sets the differential delay, {Number of sections (N)} sets the number of filter sections, {Data type specification mode} sets the word length and fraction length of filter sections and output Full, {Section fraction lengths} sets the fraction length of filter sections, {Output word length} sets the word length of filter output, {Output fraction length} sets the fraction length of filter output, {Input processing} sets the method of processing input Columns, {Rate options} sets the rate processing rule Enforce single-rate, {Filter object} sets the multirate filter object dsp.CICInterpolator System and {View Filter Response}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: Source of filter information Dialog parameters (default) | Filter object

params.name: Number of sections (N)
params.values: Number of filter sections 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Data type specification mode
params.values: Specify word length and fraction length of filter sections and output Full precision (default) | Minimum section word lengths | Specify word lengths | Binary point scaling

params.name: Section word lengths
params.values: Word length of filter sections [ 16 16 16 16 ] (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Section fraction lengths
params.values: Fraction length of filter sections 0 (default) | integer

params.name: Output word length
params.values: Word length of filter output 32 (default) | integer

params.name: Output fraction length
params.values: Fraction length of filter output 0 (default) | integer

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method of processing input Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Rate processing rule Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Filter object
params.values: Multirate filter object dsp.CICInterpolator System object
